description: This file defines a mock class for the IMediaPipelineModuleService interface used in testing media pipeline modules within the Rialto server IPC component. It includes mock methods for various IPC-related operations such as session management, media control, and source handling.

classes.name: MediaPipelineModuleServiceMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMediaPipelineModuleService interface for testing media pipeline IPC interactions.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Mocks the clientConnected method, which handles new client connections.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Mocks the clientDisconnected method, which handles client disconnections.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Mocks the createSession method, which initiates a new media session.

methods.name: destroySession
methods.description: Mocks the destroySession method, which terminates an existing media session.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Mocks the load method, which loads media content.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Mocks the setVideoWindow method, which sets the video window parameters.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Mocks the attachSource method, which attaches a media source.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Mocks the removeSource method, which removes a media source.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Mocks the allSourcesAttached method, which indicates all sources are attached.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Mocks the play method, which starts media playback.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Mocks the pause method, which pauses media playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Mocks the stop method, which stops media playback.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Mocks the setPosition method, which sets the playback position.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Mocks the haveData method, which indicates data availability.
